lines.en: I move along the wall.
I move without a whisper of sound.
My edges blur as I move.
Where I pass, it is darker.

lines.zh: 我不急，我只是一点警告
lines.en: No hurry; I am only a warning.
I slide out of the corner.
I have a little more body than a shadow.
I walk, not run, toward you.
Each step is a little nearer.
I cross your torchlight.
My black edge trails behind me.
I stand still.
I am only here to be seen.
I do not intend to do anything.
My outline is flatter than the wall.
I wait in the corner to be noticed.
I am not a threat; I am a reminder.
I lie quietly against the floor.
You should look behind you.
There is nothing at all to my face.
I neither breathe nor move.
I know the dark here well.

lines.zh: 我会一直站到你想起来
lines.en: I will stand until you remember.
I wait for you to look back.
My edge hugs the corner.
You saw me. Good.
I am reminding you of something.
You do not recall my visits.
My spot has never changed.
When you look at me, the dark looks back.

lines.zh: 我怕你忘了这里的规矩
lines.en: I feared you forgot the rules here.
My edges tremble slightly.

lines.zh: 你不该在这儿放下火把
lines.en: You should not have set the torch there.
I count how often you turn around.
I did not come to hurt you.
My silence is the message.
The light on you is shrinking.
Seeing me should make you wary.
I stay back because I need not come closer.
That wall behind you will remember.

lines.zh: 我出现过很多次，你只看见一次
lines.en: I have appeared many times; you saw once.
My shape is hard to remember.
Raise your light a little.
There is no need for you to shout.
This warning is a mild one.
You scattered some of my dark.
I scattered, then gathered again.
No pain; I only thin.
Your hand went through me.
I retreated halfway into the wall.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的边不整齐
lines.en: My edge is ragged now.
There are no wounds on me.
There is nothing solid to hit.
I am darker than I was.
I will appear again.
The light in your hand draws me more.
The food matters more to you.
I do not even have a mouth.
Set it down; I will not touch it.
That will not hold back the dark.
You think a shadow can be fed.
Eat; I will wait.
It glinted in your hand.
You passed partly through me.
I have no bones to stop you.
You shivered.
I drew aside for you.
Touch me and your hand grows cold.

lines.zh: 你穿过我，只带走一点冷。
lines.en: You pass through me and take only a little cold.
You felt no weight.
I have cleared the way for you.

lines.zh: 你脚下的影子乱了一下
lines.en: The shadow under your feet rippled.
Do not walk pressed against me.
Shadows need no pairing.
I have no shape for that.
I am only a warning.
Coming closer only brings cold.

lines.zh: 我不属于这里，也不属于谁
lines.en: I belong here and to no one.

lines.zh: 你要找的东西不在我这
lines.en: What you seek is not in me.

lines.zh: 我和墙站在一起就够了
lines.en: Standing with the wall is enough.
That question makes me darker.
You had better walk away now.
I have no hands at all.

lines.zh: 东西从我的影子里穿过去
lines.en: Things pass through my shadow.
I cannot even touch it.
It is by your feet; I can see it.
I will point out where it is.
It dimmed when it fell beside me.
You had better pick it up.
All I do is make things cold.
It rolled into the dark.
Over there, in the corner.
You have noticed me.
That is quite enough.
I do not chase; I wait.
You will look back on your own.
I chose you because you are here.

lines.zh: 你走神的这一下，我记下了
lines.en: I noted the moment you drifted.
I will follow behind you.
Do not be afraid; this is a warning.
I stand just outside your sight.
You cannot count my appearances.
What I fix on is not your life.
You are wary now. Good.
I will stay in the corner.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我可能会多一点
lines.en: Look back and I may be more.
You have remembered me.
This is not pursuit; it is following.
I am in the dark to your left.
You changed rooms; I am here too.
I occupy no space; hard to shake.

lines.zh: 你的火把只能照到近处
lines.en: Your torch only reaches so far.
I am on the wall with the other shadows.

lines.zh: 你听见我了吗，你听不见
lines.en: Can you hear me? You cannot.
Your shadow has an extra edge.
I walk beside you without a sound.
You have looked back three times.

lines.zh: 我一直在你视野的边上
lines.en: I stay at the rim of your vision.
You count torches; I count you.
Closing that door will not help.

lines.zh: 我在天花板那一片暗里
lines.en: I am in the dark patch on the ceiling.
You stop; so do I.
I never grow tired.
You are going deeper and deeper.
The dark here is mine.

lines.zh: 我不用靠近也能让你冷
lines.en: I can chill you without approaching.
Your breathing is too loud.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离不重要
lines.en: Distance does not matter between us.
My touch is light.
A chill runs through you.
What I extend is not a hand.
This blow has almost no weight.
A chill runs down your neck.
Hurting is not my talent.
You retreat; so do I.
My edge passes over you.

lines.zh: 你打了个哆嗦就没事了
lines.en: A shudder, and it is over.
This is not a blow; it is a warning.
The light on you dims a notch.
I put no strength behind it.

lines.zh: 你会觉得冷，但不会流血
lines.en: You will feel cold, not bleed.
Just this one touch.
You hear wind at your ear.
Next time I will be closer.
I appear in the corner.
A piece of darkness joins this place.

lines.zh: 你刚点亮火把，我就来了
lines.en: You lit a torch; I arrived.

lines.zh: 我一直在，只是你刚看见
lines.en: I was always here; you just saw me.
I seep out of the wall.
My arrival made no sound.
This room lost a little light.
I formed just as you turned.

lines.zh: 我不是刷怪蛋生出来的
lines.en: No spawn egg made me.

lines.zh: 我站在你照不到的角落
lines.en: I stand in the corner your light misses.
The air dropped a degree.
I appear flat against the floor.

lines.zh: 你先看见我的边，再看见我
lines.en: You see my edge before you see me.
This room is starting to feel wrong.

lines.zh: 我没有走进来，我本来就在
lines.en: I did not enter; I was already here.
I appear behind the door.
Do not light a second torch.

lines.zh: 这次出现的形状更清楚
lines.en: This shape came out clearer.
I wait for you to look this way.
The firelight shows me too clearly.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，落下来也无声
lines.en: Weightless; my fall makes no sound.
The dark is thicker underwater.
The arrow passed through me.
The spell fixed my shape.
Hunger has nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 雷光把每个角落都照亮了
lines.en: Lightning lit every corner.
This dark is purer than I am.
